commons.title: Camp of the Gros Ventres of the prairies on the upper Missouri LCCN2003654204.jpg
commons.description:
Title: Camp of the Gros Ventres of the prairies on the upper Missouri
Abstract: Print shows a large Hidatsa Indians camp in the background; a group of Indians in the foreground are dancing on the shore while others are in the water boarding and attacking passengers on a ship.
Physical description: 1 print : engraving and aquatint.

Notes: Carl Bodmer, pinx ad nat. ; Himely, sculp. ; Arthus Bertrand, éditeur.; Tab. 38.; Same title also in German and French precedes the English.; Title from item.
commons.editorial_reason: Although the title names Gros Ventre, the description specifically identifies the depicted camp as Hidatsa, creating an attribution disagreement.
